summary: Scheduled burst credit rollback mismatch after usage reconciliation
description: Issue summary: BrightWell Health reports a larger-than-expected negative invoice line after an automated scheduled burst-credit rollback ran as part of nightly usage reconciliation. Impact: customer saw a -$4,200 line (credit removal) on their March 1 invoice that they do not expect; this caused their billing automation to fail and blocked payment processing. Environment: Dedicated customer during prod reconciliation window in us-east. Initial hypothesis: rollback job applied twice (scheduled rollback + late postback delta) across mixed subaccount IDs during the same reconciliation cycle.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer had an active scheduled promotional burst-credit window from 2026-02-20 to 2026-02-27.
2) On 2026-02-27 at 02:00 UTC the scheduled rollback job executed to remove burst credits for expired promotion.
3) Between 02:10 and 03:00 UTC late usage postbacks for queued batch jobs arrived and were applied by the postback-processor.
4) Nightly reconciliation job aggregated both the rollback delta and the late-postback adjustments and produced a combined negative line for the customer.
5) Invoice generation included the combined negative line; customer reports the magnitude is larger than expected and attribution is unclear.
observed_behavior: A single negative invoice line of -$4,200 labeled 'scheduled-burst-credit-rollback' appears on the March 1 invoice. Customer asserts expected rollback was -$1,200. Discrepancy of -$3,000 unexplained.
expected_behavior: Scheduled rollback should remove only the promotional burst credits granted for the specified dates. Late postbacks should be separately recorded as usage adjustments, not double-applied to the same credit rollback. The net invoice delta should match ledger audit records.
logs: recon-run-2026-02-27.log: reconciler.job_id=R20260227-11 entries show rollback.delta=-4200 applied
postback-processor-2026-02-27.log: multiple late postbacks received for subaccount IDs 4521, 4521-legacy, timestamps 02:12-02:47 UTC
billing-ledger-2026-02-27.csv: line item scheduled_rollback, amount=-4200, reason=promotion-end
investigation_notes: 2026-02-27 09:40 - Support (Priya): validated invoice snapshot and customer-provided CSV. 2026-02-27 11:05 - Billing (Samir): initial analysis shows two distinct deltas in recon output: one from scheduled rollback (expected -1200) and one from late usage adjustments (approx -3000). Both deltas are tied to overlapping mapped subaccount identifiers (4521 vs 4521-legacy). Hypothesis: reconciliation pipeline failed to dedupe rollback events and late postback adjustments when subaccount aliasing (legacy IDs) is present. Also observed that the scheduled rollback used a reconciliation window that included the late-postback timeframe due to a cron misalignment with DST-localized customer timezone.
customer_impact: Customer's accounting automation rejected the invoice; finance team flagged payment hold. Operational impact: customer-facing support call scheduled. Risk of churn if not resolved within 48h.
mitigation_steps_taken: 1) Temporarily paused automated retry for invoice acceptance for BrightWell to prevent auto-withdrawal of funds. 2) Issued provisional credit of $3,000 to restore expected balance pending final reconciliation (manual action on 2026-02-28 by Billing). 3) Opened postback reprocessing ticket with infra (linked in linked_issues).
resolution: In Progress - manual provisional credit applied. Root cause under investigation: reconciliation dedupe logic with aliased subaccount IDs and scheduling window overlap. Pending code fix to dedupe identical credit rollback events and adjust reconciliation window boundaries. Billing has committed to a permanent credit if final reconciliation confirms over-deduction.
next_steps: 1) Engineering to add dedupe key (promotion_id + canonical_subaccount_id) to scheduled rollback events - owner: @samir (ETA 2026-03-05)
2) Re-run reconciliation for 2026-02-27 after dedupe patch in staging and verify ledger matches customer expectation - owner: billing-team
3) Add integration test covering late postbacks arriving during rollback window - owner: infra-qa
4) Update runbook: explicitly separate scheduled rollback window and late-postback aggregation window to avoid overlap - owner: ops
5) Follow up with BrightWell with final reconciliation report and any permanent credits applied (target 2026-03-06).
